stateAttributes.meaning: The typed text the create option would commit; rewritten as the person types.

stateAttributes.meaning: The side the open listbox was placed on (bottom-start, or top-start after a flip when the field is near the viewport's bottom).

notes: Label and hint sit on the value's text column (1px border + 8px padding); the 44px field matches a themed wa-input.

obligations: Native input with role=combobox, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-activedescendant; options are role=option in a listbox. The visible label is a real label; the hint is aria-describedby.

The suggestion listbox is a manual popover in the top layer, placed below the field at its width and flipped when short, so a clipping or scrolling ancestor (an AnchoredSurface, a dialog, a scrolling List) never cuts it off.

notes: Label, hint, and error sit on the value's text column (1px border + 8px padding); the 44px box matches Button and Select, and compact matches their compact 33px.

obligations: The whole field is a <label> around a native <input> or <textarea>, so clicking anywhere on it focuses the field; the input is named by label (aria-label, with the visible label text hidden from assistive technology so the clear button and count stay out of the name) or by ariaLabel. Focus shows the standard focus ring around the box.

The hint and error are visible below the field and form the input's aria-description; an error also sets aria-invalid="true". The clear button is a native button named by clearLabel (default Clear), hidden while the field is empty, and returns focus to the field.
Compact text grows to 16px on coarse-pointer touch screens so iOS does not zoom on focus.

notes: A 20px box (18px compact) 8px (7px) before its label; hint and error sit directly under the label, on its text column, like a grouped choice hint. Stack standalone Checkboxes in a List gap="xs" (8px), the same 28px pitch as RadioGroup choices.

obligations: A native <input type="checkbox"> inside its <label>, invisibly over the drawn box, so the label names it and pointer, keyboard, touch exploration, and forms reach the real control; Space toggles it and focus shows the focus ring on the box.

The hint and error form the input's aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid="true" and the danger border. indeterminate sets the native indeterminate property through wireCheckboxes, so assistive technology reports a mixed state.

notes: Laid out exactly like a RadioGroup: the label and hint sit on the text column (1px + 8px); each choice's 20px box (18px compact) sits on the group's inline-start edge 8px (7px) before its label; choices stack 8px apart (--kui-space-xs), the same 28px pitch as RadioGroup choices, wrap with a 24px column gap when horizontal, and a choice hint sits directly under its label text.

obligations: A native <fieldset> (a group) named by its legend (label), ariaLabel, or labelledBy; each choice is a Kerf Checkbox, a native checkbox inside its <label>, invisibly over the drawn box. Every checkbox is its own Tab stop and Space toggles it; each checked value submits under name.

The group's hint and error form its aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid on the group and the danger border on each box. A choice's hint is that checkbox's aria-description. disabled disables the fieldset, and so every checkbox, natively.

notes: The label and hint sit on the text column (1px + 8px); each choice's 20px circle (18px compact) sits on the group's inline-start edge, where a Checkbox draws its box, 8px (7px) before its label; choices stack 8px apart (--kui-space-xs), the same 28px pitch as Checkboxes in a List gap="xs", and a choice hint aligns with its label text.

obligations: A native <fieldset role="radiogroup"> named by its legend (label) or ariaLabel; each choice is a native radio inside its <label>, invisibly over the drawn circle. The browser owns the interaction: one Tab stop, arrow keys move and select, and the checked radio submits its value under name.

The group's hint and error form its aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid on the group and the danger border on each circle. required sets each radio's native required and aria-required on the group. A choice's hint is that radio's aria-description.

notes: A 35×20 track (31.5×18 compact) 8px (7px) before its label; the hint sits directly under the label, on its text column, like a Checkbox hint.

obligations: A native <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> inside its <label>, invisibly over the drawn track, so the label names it and assistive technology announces on or off; Space toggles it and focus shows the focus ring on the track. The hint is its aria-description. The thumb's slide is skipped when reduced motion is preferred.

state.id: the value (read it on input or change through action) and re-rendering with it

notes: It fills the available width with the shared block-content inset (a transparent 1px border and 8px padding), so its label sits on the text column.

obligations: It is a native range input: arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home, and End step it, and the platform announces its value (with a unit, as aria-valuetext).
The label names it, the hint describes it, and the readout is hidden from assistive technology because the input already reports its value; forced colors draw a Highlight fill on a GrayText track.

state.id: opening trigger and programmatic close after an action

obligations: The non-modal surface has role dialog and the required label. Focus moves to the first focusable descendant by default and returns to the opener on close; initialFocus: false leaves focus on the trigger. Escape and outside press dismiss by default.

state.id: the checked state of checkbox choices, which the menu reports as requested in its kui-menu-select event
reactions to the menu opening or closing
contextmenu event handling and identification of the menu root when using a pointer-anchored context menu

obligations: The trigger is a native button with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded; an icon-only trigger requires label, rendered as visually hidden text inside the button, and a trigger with visible text is named by that text. The context anchor stays out of the accessibility tree. The open menu (role="menu") takes the trigger's name, each submenu takes its parent item's label, and a heading names the role="group" that holds its items, so a screen reader announces named menus and getByRole('menu', { name }) finds them. Items are menuitem or menuitemcheckbox buttons with aria-checked and aria-disabled.

Keyboard: Enter, Space, or ArrowDown on the trigger opens on the first item (ArrowUp on the last); ArrowUp/ArrowDown move and wrap past disabled items, Home/End jump, and typing a label's first letters moves to it; Enter or Space chooses; ArrowRight opens a submenu on its first item and ArrowLeft returns to the parent item (mirrored right to left); Escape closes the current level and returns focus to its opener; Tab closes the menu and continues from the trigger.

Once registered, an icon-only trigger shows its label as an aria-hidden help tag after a 500ms hover and at once on keyboard focus; it hides while the menu is open, on a press, and on Escape, and never joins aria-labelledby. Do not add a title or another tooltip.

state.id: the label and its delegated action
which step is current when currentStep marks a sequence
what a press does while loading

obligations: A native <button> (type="button" unless set) or, with href, an <a>; its label names it, or ariaLabel when the label is not enough. Focus shows the standard focus ring 1px outside the box; with focusRingInset it is drawn inside the box, two-tone with a surface-colored line inside the ring color, so it keeps 3:1 contrast on a loud fill of its own hue.

Loading shows a spinner in place of the label, which still names the button, and sets aria-busy="true". A disabled link drops its href and reports aria-disabled="true". Disabled success uses a quiet success fill and readable on-fill text instead of fading the label.

With pressed, it is a toggle: aria-pressed reports the state, and the pressed look adds a doubled outline (secondary and plain) or a darkened fill with an inset ring (primary), so the state never relies on hue alone; forced-colors mode paints it Highlight. An icon-only Button is named by ariaLabel, and help tags show that name on hover and keyboard focus. A title gives native hover text that says more than the name and replaces the help tag.
With currentStep, a native button or link reports aria-current="step" even when disabled; the app owns the step label and which step is current.

state.id: the options menu and its open state
the running state, tone switch, and copy

obligations: Both halves are native buttons in a group; the options trigger exposes aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, and optional aria-controls, and needs optionsLabel. busy sets aria-busy on the primary.
Each half draws the focus ring 1px outside its box; with focusRingInset it is drawn inside, two-tone with a surface-colored line inside the ring color, so it keeps 3:1 contrast on every loud fill.

state.id: what happens to the reported files (upload, validation, limits)

obligations: Reports chosen and dropped files and accepts drops on the zone; without it drops open the file in the browser.

stateAttributes.name: data-dragging

obligations: Each control is a label around a real file input that receives keyboard focus; the visible control shows the focus ring. Give the input an accessibleLabel when the visible copy is short.
Choose polite status versus assertive alert deliberately.
Use alert urgency only for an attention-requiring failure.
Keep optional badge content terse and do not rely on its tone alone for meaning.

an app-owned container with data-placement="top" for top-edge stacking

notes: The region insets 16px from the viewport edge plus the safe area and caps its width at 480px; toasts stack with an 8px gap.

Toasts dismiss themselves after four seconds by default; give longer messages a longer duration, and never rely on a toast for the only path to an action.
The entrance and exit only fade under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch, and forced colors draw a CanvasText border on Canvas.

placement, delay, and native top-layer hosting
the disposer that removes a tooltip's listeners

The loud neutral fill with on-loud text meets WCAG AA; forced colors draw CanvasText on Canvas, and the entrance is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch.

the composed StateBanner copy and progress

Opening never moves focus, and there is no close button, light dismiss, or Escape handling to compete with dialogs.
A modal dialog opened while it shows stacks above it and makes it inert (unannounced); show progress the dialog's task depends on inside the dialog.

notes: Fixed to the top edge below the device safe area; it allocates no layout.

Busy state uses aria-busy; the illustration never supplies the only label.
Labeled spinners use role img; decorative spinners are hidden and stop for reduced motion.

notes: It fills the available width with the shared block-content inset (a transparent 1px border and 8px padding); the label row sits 4px above the track.

obligations: The native progress element is the progressbar: a visible label names it through aria-labelledby (or ariaLabel without one), and valueText replaces the spoken percentage.
The indeterminate sweep holds still under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch; forced colors draw a CanvasText-bordered track with a Highlight fill.

notes: Its box is exactly its diameter, so it aligns with icons of the same size.

obligations: It is role progressbar named by label, with aria-valuenow as a percentage (or valueText); the SVG is decorative.
The spin holds still under prefers-reduced-motion or the static-effects switch; forced colors draw a GrayText track and a Highlight arc.
Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass label to announce it as an image. A component in placeholder mode marks itself aria-busy and disables its own controls.

diagnostics.when: tab and panel name sets differ
diagnostics.message: Every wa-tab must identify a matching wa-tab-panel and vice versa.

notes: Container-mode tab panels own the themed container inset; uncontained panels do not.

obligations: Each pane has one scroll owner and each resize handle keeps its separator keyboard contract.
Native buttons retain names, current state, sequential focus, and disclosure state; rows and standalone footer actions remain at least 44px tall.
Heading order and action focus order remain stable when controls wrap.

ListDetailDialog's native modal dialog owns focus, Escape, and inertness, and returns focus to the opener on close; the close control sits in the detail column (or each compact view), and the compact NavStack back control returns to the list.

The form references its ToolbarText title and supporting-summary ids; production fields own labels and help; invalid submission creates an assertive persistent StateBanner while successful submission creates a polite persistent banner.
Busy, polite, and assertive states use the appropriate production feedback semantics.
Each control retains its own native name, pressed/value state, and keyboard contract.
The back control is a real button; reduced motion collapses the slide to instant.
Each component marks itself aria-busy and disables its own controls while loading; the composition keeps labels and structure stable across the transition.

Each panel is a labeled aside that is aria-hidden while collapsed; toggles carry aria-expanded and the standard per-side glyph; while compact an open panel is an overlay with a backdrop, Escape and backdrop-click dismiss, and a trapped Tab ring.

the artwork's bottom color and the scheme it belongs to (the tint)

obligations: Glass control groups keep every chrome control at AA over the artwork; the tint clamps text to AA over the tinted surface; parallax, blur, and the scroll-edge fade go static under reduced motion or the static-effects switch, and the chrome and fade go opaque under reduced transparency and increased contrast.
